entries.title: Exaltation (uccha)
entries.body: Exalted means a planet occupies a sign this tradition treats as supportive. It is a chart classification, not a measure of talent or a promise of good events. Other chart conditions are considered separately. Reflection: where could preparation and support help you make use of an opportunity?

entries.title: Own sign (svakshetra)
entries.body: An own sign is a sign traditionally associated with that planet. Astrologers use the image of being at home to discuss a familiar way of expressing its theme. This does not guarantee confidence, stability or protection. Reflection: which familiar approach helps you, and when would another approach be useful?

entries.title: Friendly sign
entries.body: Friendly describes a traditional relationship between planets in a table, not whether you or another person are friendly. You can use the symbolism to reflect on cooperation without treating it as a prediction. Reflection: what kind of support would make your next step easier?

entries.title: Neutral sign
entries.body: Neutral means the selected planet-relationship table assigns neither friendship nor enmity here. It does not mean an average personality or an unimportant life area. Lived experience comes first. Reflection: what do you actually notice in this area, without forcing a label onto it?

entries.title: Enemy sign
entries.body: Enemy is an old technical term for a relationship between planets. It does not identify an enemy in your life or predict conflict. A more useful reflection is how two priorities might need balancing. Reflection: what would a workable compromise look like while respecting your boundaries?

entries.title: Debilitation (neecha)
entries.body: Debilitated is a traditional sign classification, not a disability, failure or personal weakness. The engine separately checks conditions that offset this label. There is no requirement to suffer before succeeding. Reflection: what practical support would help you approach a difficulty on your own terms?

entries.title: Exalted Sun

This does not establish leadership ability, health, recognition or relationships with a parent. Your actual circumstances and choices matter more than this label. Reflection: How can you state what you need while leaving room for another person's view?
